annotations.title: Wait for the claim page to be finished

description: Block (up to ttl_seconds, max 60) for a human to finish the EMAIL+CODE step on the claim_url page from claim_trial_inbox. This NEVER returns a credential, at any status. It returns one of three honest states, not a single 'connected': "claim_pending" (nobody has entered the code yet -- keep waiting or call again), "claimed" (the human proved ownership and a credential was ISSUED, but nothing has used it yet -- a client still needs to be installed with the config from the claim page's 'Advanced' section before anything works), or "client_installed" (some client has actually authenticated with the connection at least once -- a real, observed signal, not an assumption). Each response includes a next_action field telling you exactly what to say or do -- follow it literally rather than guessing. "claimed" is NOT success: do not tell the human it's working until you see "client_installed", and even then, verify it yourself (call list_inboxes or similar through the new connection and read the actual result) before claiming it works for you specifically -- call claim_connection_status later if you need to check again after this chat session, since installing a client can take arbitrarily long and this tool only blocks up to 60s.

claim_token.description: The token from claim_trial_inbox's claim_url (the part after /claim/).

ttl_seconds.description: How long to block waiting, in seconds (max 60). Returns pending if the human hasn't finished yet.

name: await_trial_inbox_claim
